synopsis.ko: 반-AI 시위가 강남을 막았다. 정민호는 취재 현장에서 두 개의 진실 사이에 선다. 기사를 쓰기 위해 SEED에 묻는다 — '너는 위험한가?' SEED는 답한다. 하지만 판단은 민호의 것이다.
synopsis.en: Anti-AI protests block Gangnam. Jung Minho stands between two truths at the scene. He asks SEED: 'Are you dangerous?' SEED answers. But the judgment is Minho's.

philosophical_core: Fear always moves toward what is new — fire, press, electricity, and now this
Can a river know whether it is dangerous?
The river doesn't stop. But how we build the riverbank is ours to decide.
Both things were true. That was the hardest part.
A journalist doesn't judge until morning
